note: 12 Nov: REAP calibration of Riker (28Bob) and Bobert (35Bob) Q4 at 12 experts per word, served by Brain Engine (live expert switch + expert mass). For each: the quick quiz on Bob 1.5.208 and on 1.5.208 with the tool fixes (every tool group on, four seeded how-tos), then reap-calibrate: REAP scores on 100 training lessons, then 100/75/50/35% of each layer's experts kept, each step judged on the held-out chats. No file is cut. About 3.5 h on an A40, about $2-2.50; caps 4.5 h / $5.
step_up_note: a benchmark only: any card with room for a 20 GB file will do, the list is cheapest first

benchmark.note: the quiz runs are minutes apart, so their time-stamped reports don't collide; reap-calibrate puts the mask back to all-on before the pod moves to the next brain
